# Replace the README hero with the v13.2 Dock Layouts film

## Context

Tobi's October 11 release directive accepts the finished Workstation film and requests its YouTube publication, then replacement of the Engine README's previous Fleet Manager video. Grace's #19604 owns the release-note embed; Ada's #19602 owns the blog.

## The Problem

The README hero still links to `H5zR63tVrmo` and its Fleet Manager poster. The Dock Layouts film needs the same prominent entry point before the v13.2 package cut.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: the operator's current directive to replace the previous README video. The existing linked-image block is at `README.md:22`. The accepted film and illustrated cover are retained under production epic #15252. Release image hosting is Pages-owned at `resources_pub/website/release-notes/v13.2.0/`; the absolute cover URL can be shared by README, notes and blog.

## The Fix

After publication returns a stable, verified YouTube URL and the accepted cover has a verified public URL, replace the README hero's two video links, image source, alt text and watch caption. Preserve the surrounding organism/Body/Brain narrative. Hand the same two URLs to the notes and blog owners.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The hero image and watch caption link to the published Dock Layouts film, replacing the previous video.
- [x] The hero uses the accepted cover through its durable Pages URL and has accurate alt text and a responsive width.
- [x] Both public URLs resolve and the rendered README block is checked; notes/blog owners receive the same references.

## Completion receipt — 2026-10-11

- Human merge: #19611 at `a2a7d5779b113ce66f7457881854b4c4b833b44c`; cover producer `neomjs/pages#29` at `9e33814ce5c0f8ec3bc9a677fb4e3ebecbf915a2`.
- The public [film](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KESyjFmOz0k) plays and offers 2160p60. Its accepted cover is visible; no additional English caption track was uploaded.
- The [raw-main cover](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neomjs/pages/main/resources_pub/website/release-notes/v13.2.0/workstation-film-cover.png) returns HTTP 200 and the accepted SHA-256 `cbf0a4d8e3aa93e5606331f785123eb2337099f03bb3e662c311f10dbad4aede` (1,818,403 bytes).
- The [rendered dev README](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/README.md) displays the complete cover at its preserved aspect ratio and links the image and caption to the film. Notes and blog owners received the same references.
- Timing correction: the operator merged the README before the cover producer; final cover/render verification occurred after those merges. AC-3 records the completed verification rather than claiming it preceded handoff.

## Out of Scope

Film re-recording, narration changes, release-note or blog authorship, release designation, npm/Pages release execution, or removal of the older retained video/poster.

## Avoided Traps

No placeholder video ID, unpublished cover URL, duplicate Engine cover copy, or claim that an upload response alone proves public playback.

Decision Record impact: none; bounded existing README media replacement. No runtime API or new architectural surface.
